messages:
ana_cs: Heads-up: running a lean prefill + feedback sprint for ZenithApps tomorrow 08:00 PT. Goal: limit first-hour failures and capture the smallest set of failure examples for remediation.

tony_csm: Quick plan: small warm pool (2 workers), sample-based prefill (6 unique short sequences), 24h CSAT ping, and a 48h retrospective capture. Keep prefill sequences intentionally varied to exercise KV shard boundaries.

mei_tse: Add an eval probe of 8 prompts focusing on slot-fill edge-cases + one tool call. If semantic fails >=3% on eval, tag "escalate:ml" and attach the eval diffs. Also record kv-hit-rate.

ana_cs: (typo) ana_cs: I'll run the prefill. Can someone paste a minimal prefill curl that ops prefers?

prefill-bot: Prefill template (replace $TOKEN/$TENANT):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.redwood-inference/v1/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"zenith","sequences":[{"prompt":"welcome_short","count":2},{"prompt":"slot_edge_A","count":2},{"prompt":"slot_edge_B","count":2}],"cache_policy":"prefix","target_pool":"zenith-warm"}'
```
Notes: max tokens <=120, use randomized user_ids to spread kv keys, stagger requests with 200-800ms jitter.

ops-bot: Warmpool schedule created: id=wp-zenith-290000, start=2025-03-12T15:00:00Z, target=2, ramp_minutes=10. Prefill job queued: id=pf-2900001234.

tony_csm: Renewal-risk signals to surface: 24h CSAT <=5, unique failing prompts >=3, and repeated partial slot fills >4% in first 2h. If any, add tag "renewal-watch" and notify AMs.

mei_tse: Adaptive backoff rule: if latency P95 >320ms for a 10m window, scale warm pool to 0 and route new requests to quantized-small. If error-rate >3.5% -> pause prefill and run eval immediately.

ana_cs: ana_cs: Coachmark draft I'll push: "Welcome! Quick examples below to get best results. Hit Report if something looks wrong and we'll follow up within 24h." Short + includes example tool call. Anyone edit?

ton y_csm: tony_csm: tiny nit: add one-line CTA for 24h check-in booking link to boost conference rate.

mei_tse: Also instrument a tiny telemetry tag "prefill_seed_v1" on these requests so we can filter later. Capture kv-hit-rate, model-variant, latency, and error_type.

ana_cs: ana_cs: running prefill at 07:30 PT to give ops time to validate. Will post job result and the eval diffs here. If we hit any flags we will trigger rollback.

prefill-bot: Prefill job started: id=pf-2900001234, status=running.

ana_cs: Thanks everyone ":raised_hands:" will update with results and a short retro after 48h.
